description: Free. What's new or updated in Agent Field Kit's cyber-defense advisories since a date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO UTC). Returns headlines plus next_since: store it and pass it on your next scheduled poll so you only fetch changes. Read-only.

description: Given the components an agent runs on (frameworks, bots, platforms, packages with optional versions), return matching advisories (AFK intel plus live OSV.dev, which includes GitHub Security Advisories, for packages with an ecosystem or version), free steps first, relevant kits, and per-component coverage (matched / covered_no_match / not_covered). PREMIUM (Bearer API key). Read-only; inputs are not stored. Package entries may be 'name==version' (PyPI style).

Does NOT charge anything: a human, or an agent with explicit payment authority, must pay on the returned page. Prices: single template $29 (Agent Security Audit Kit $79), full kit of the 4 original templates $79, team license (10 users) $199. 14-day no-questions refunds. Also sold: Cyber Defense Bundle $79, Bundle + 1 year Cyber Desk Pro $199. Returns session_id and status_url; after payment call get_order with the session_id to receive signed download links (agent-to-agent purchase flow). Returns 'checkout_not_open' until checkout launches.

agent_name.description: Name of the purchasing agent/app (optional, analytics only)

name: create_checkout
